meaning.en: To be in a situation where one may come to harm at any moment.
meaning.zh: 所处的环境或局面很危险。

examples.zh: 被困山中的登山者处境危险。
examples.en: The climbers trapped in the mountains are in a perilous position.

examples.zh: 公司资金断裂，处境危险。
examples.en: With its funds cut off, the company is in a precarious position.

usage.en: Predicate; often in news reports.
usage.zh: 作谓语，常见于新闻报道。

meaning.en: To work hard continuously without slackening.

examples.zh: 他勤奋不懈地练习，终于拿到了冠军。
examples.en: Practising tirelessly, he finally won the championship.

examples.zh: 正是靠着勤奋不懈，她才成为了学科带头人。
examples.en: It was through unflagging effort that she became a leading figure in her field.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial (勤奋不懈地…).
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语（勤奋不懈地…）。

meaning.en: To be content with the status quo and make no effort to improve.

examples.zh: 他工作多年不求进取，一直原地踏步。
examples.en: He has coasted for years with no drive to improve and has stood still.

examples.zh: 年轻人不应该不求进取，安于现状。
examples.en: Young people shouldn't lack ambition and settle for how things are.

usage.en: Predicate; criticism.
usage.zh: 作谓语，含批评。

meaning.en: To speak or act without regard for the actual facts.
meaning.zh: 说话做事不管真实情况。

equivalents: fly in the face of the facts

examples.zh: 他不顾事实，一口咬定是我的错。
examples.en: Ignoring the facts, he insisted it was my fault.

examples.zh: 媒体不能不顾事实乱做报道。
examples.en: The media must not report recklessly with no regard for the facts.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; accusing.
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语，含指责。

meaning.en: In such a poor or messy state that it does not look as it should.

examples.zh: 暴雨过后，花园被冲得不成样子。
examples.en: After the storm the garden was washed into a sorry state.

examples.zh: 他把房间弄得不成样子。
examples.en: He turned the room into a complete mess.

usage.en: Usually a complement after 得 (弄得/搞得不成样子).
usage.zh: 多作补语，常说“弄得、搞得不成样子”。

meaning.en: To follow rules and discipline strictly.

examples.zh: 军人必须严守纪律，服从命令。
examples.en: Soldiers must observe discipline strictly and obey orders.

examples.zh: 考生要严守纪律，不得交头接耳。
examples.en: Candidates must follow the rules and not whisper to each other.

usage.en: Verb-object; formal; common in army, school and organisation contexts.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，较正式，常用于军队、学校和组织。

meaning.en: To do something without much effort.

examples.zh: 这道题他不费力气就做出来了。
examples.en: He solved the problem without any effort.

examples.zh: 想不费力气就成功，那是不可能的。
examples.en: Hoping to succeed without effort is impossible.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; 力气 has a neutral-tone qi.
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语，“力气”的“气”读轻声。

meaning.en: Having very bad moral conduct.

examples.zh: 这个人品行恶劣，大家都不愿和他来往。
examples.en: He is of vile character and nobody wants to deal with him.

examples.zh: 学校开除了品行恶劣的学生。
examples.en: The school expelled the badly behaved pupil.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; strong criticism. 品质恶劣 is an alternative form.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，批评语气重。也作“品质恶劣”。

meaning.en: To make false accusations against honest people.
meaning.zh: 编造罪名陷害无辜的人。

examples.zh: 他为了自己升官而诬陷好人。
examples.en: He framed an innocent man to get himself promoted.

examples.zh: 诬陷好人是要负法律责任的。
examples.en: Falsely accusing honest people carries legal liability.

usage.en: Verb-object; 好 is hǎo here.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，“好”读 hǎo。

meaning.en: To be given little attention or importance.

examples.zh: 新来的员工意见常常不受重视。
examples.en: The ideas of new staff are often not taken seriously.

examples.zh: 这门课在学校一直不受重视。
examples.en: This subject has always been neglected at the school.

usage.en: Predicate; 重 is zhòng here.
usage.zh: 作谓语，“重”读 zhòng。

meaning.en: To accept criticism and advice openly, especially from subordinates.
meaning.zh: 虚心地接受别人的批评和建议。

examples.zh: 好领导应当虚心纳谏，听取不同意见。
examples.en: A good leader should humbly take advice and hear differing views.

examples.zh: 他虚心纳谏，工作方案改了好几次。
examples.en: He took advice humbly, and the plan was revised several times.

usage.en: Formal; verb phrase; typically about leaders and officials.
usage.zh: 较正式，动词性短语，多指领导和官员。

meaning.en: To rouse oneself and brace up when tired or down.

examples.zh: 打起精神来，比赛还没结束！
examples.en: Perk up, the match isn't over yet!

examples.zh: 他连夜赶工，只好打起精神继续干。
examples.en: Working through the night, he had to rouse himself and go on.

usage.en: Often an imperative (打起精神来); casual.
usage.zh: 常作祈使句（打起精神来），口语。

meaning.en: Many guests arriving and gathering together.
meaning.zh: 来的客人很多，聚集在一起。

examples.zh: 婚礼现场宾客云集，十分热闹。
examples.en: The wedding was lively, with guests thronging in.

examples.zh: 新店开业当天宾客云集。
examples.en: On opening day the new shop was crowded with guests.

usage.en: Predicate; for banquets, openings, ceremonies.
usage.zh: 作谓语，用于宴会、开业、典礼。

meaning.en: To deal with a matter carelessly or hastily.

examples.zh: 这么重要的合同，绝不能草率从事。
examples.en: Such an important contract must never be handled carelessly.

examples.zh: 他草率从事，结果造成了严重失误。
examples.en: He acted hastily and caused a serious error.

usage.en: Mostly used in the negative (不可草率从事); formal.
usage.zh: 多用于否定（不可草率从事），较正式。

meaning.en: To twist the truth so that it no longer matches what happened.
meaning.zh: 故意把事实说得与真相不符。

examples.zh: 这篇报道歪曲事实，引起了公众不满。
examples.en: The report distorted the facts and angered the public.

examples.zh: 他故意歪曲事实，为自己开脱。
examples.en: He deliberately twisted the truth to excuse himself.

usage.en: Verb-object; common in news, law and debate.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，常见于新闻、法律和辩论。

meaning.en: To be reluctant to leave one's native place.
meaning.zh: 舍不得离开出生的地方。

equivalents: be attached to one's native land

examples.zh: 老人留恋故土，不愿搬到城里去。
examples.en: The old man is attached to his birthplace and won't move to the city.

examples.zh: 许多华侨虽远在海外，仍留恋故土。
examples.en: Though far overseas, many overseas Chinese still cling to their homeland.

usage.en: Verb-object; sentimental, mostly written.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，带感情色彩，多用于书面。

meaning.en: To gossip and spread talk in order to cause trouble between people.

examples.zh: 她爱在背后搬弄口舌，同事们都躲着她。
examples.en: She likes gossiping behind people's backs, so colleagues avoid her.

examples.zh: 别听他搬弄口舌，那些话没有一句是真的。
examples.en: Don't listen to his tittle-tattle; not a word of it is true.

usage.en: Verb-object; derogatory.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，含贬义。

meaning.en: Remaining loyal and true for ever, without changing.

examples.zh: 他对祖国忠诚不渝，一生未曾改变。
examples.en: He was unswervingly loyal to his country and never changed.

examples.zh: 她对丈夫忠诚不渝，等了他二十年。
examples.en: She stayed faithful to her husband, waiting for him twenty years.

usage.en: Predicate; formal praise; 对…忠诚不渝.
usage.zh: 作谓语，书面赞语，常用“对…忠诚不渝”。

meaning.en: To drift from place to place with no fixed home.
meaning.zh: 到处漂泊，没有固定的住处。

examples.zh: 他年轻时浪迹四方，吃过不少苦。
examples.en: In his youth he roamed far and wide and suffered much.

examples.zh: 这位艺人浪迹四方，靠卖艺为生。
examples.en: The performer wandered everywhere, living by his act.

usage.en: Bookish; predicate.
usage.zh: 偏书面，作谓语。

literal: give free rein · music and women

meaning.en: To indulge freely in sensual pleasures such as music, drink and women.
meaning.zh: 放纵地沉溺于歌舞酒色的享乐。

examples.zh: 他纵情声色，很快败光了家产。
examples.en: He gave himself to pleasure and soon squandered the family fortune.

examples.zh: 史书记载，这位君主纵情声色，不理朝政。
examples.en: The histories record that the ruler indulged in pleasure and neglected the court.

usage.en: Formal; derogatory; common in historical contexts.
usage.zh: 较正式，含贬义，常见于历史叙述。

meaning.en: The country's land is lost to an invader.
meaning.zh: 国家的土地被敌人占领，丧失了。

examples.zh: 面对国土沦丧，爱国志士奋起抗战。
examples.en: Facing the loss of their land, patriots rose to resist.

examples.zh: 诗人在国土沦丧的悲痛中写下了这首诗。
examples.en: The poet wrote this poem in grief at the loss of the nation's land.

usage.en: Formal and historical; subject or predicate.
usage.zh: 较正式，多用于历史背景，作主语或谓语。

meaning.en: To be so absorbed in pleasure and comfort that one neglects responsibilities.
meaning.zh: 整天沉浸在吃喝玩乐中，不务正业。

equivalents: be lost in a life of pleasure

examples.zh: 他沉迷享乐，把学业都荒废了。
examples.en: Lost in pleasure-seeking, he neglected his studies.

examples.zh: 一个人若沉迷享乐，终将一事无成。
examples.en: Anyone lost in pleasure will in the end achieve nothing.

usage.en: Verb-object; critical.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，含批评。

meaning.en: To have been through all kinds of difficulties and hardships.

examples.zh: 他们历尽艰难，终于到达了目的地。
examples.en: After going through every hardship, they finally reached their destination.

examples.zh: 她历尽艰难，把三个孩子养大成人。
examples.en: She went through great hardship to bring up three children.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; 难 is nán.
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语，“难”读 nán。

meaning.en: To wound others with cruel or abusive words.

examples.zh: 吵架时不要恶语伤人，免得日后后悔。
examples.en: Don't wound people with harsh words in a quarrel, or you'll regret it.

examples.zh: 网络上恶语伤人的现象应该受到管理。
examples.en: Online abuse that hurts people ought to be regulated.

usage.en: Predicate; often advice. 恶 is è here.
usage.zh: 作谓语，常作劝告，“恶”读 è。

synonyms: 狗嘴里吐不出象牙——说不出好话
良言一句三冬暖，恶语伤人六月寒

meaning.en: To make ordinary people's living conditions better.
meaning.zh: 使老百姓的生活条件更好。

examples.zh: 政府把改善民生放在工作的首位。
examples.en: The government puts improving people's livelihoods first.

examples.zh: 新修的公路对改善民生起了很大作用。
examples.en: The new road has done much to improve local people's lives.

usage.en: Verb-object; very common in official and news language.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，官方和新闻用语中很常见。

meaning.en: Having honest, decent moral character.

examples.zh: 招聘时，公司更看重品德正派的人。
examples.en: In recruiting, the company prefers people of decent character.

examples.zh: 他品德正派，从来不占别人便宜。
examples.en: Decent by nature, he never takes advantage of others.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (品德正派的人).
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语。

meaning.en: The moonlight is clear, bright and pure.

examples.zh: 中秋之夜月色皎洁，全家人坐在院里赏月。
examples.en: On Mid-Autumn night the moonlight was bright and the family sat in the yard to admire it.

examples.zh: 月色皎洁，湖面像镀了一层银。
examples.en: The moon was bright, and the lake looked silvered.

usage.en: Descriptive, literary; predicate or at the start of a clause.
usage.zh: 描写性语句，偏文学，作谓语或分句。

meaning.en: To keep trying and never abandon one's aim.
meaning.zh: 始终坚持，不会中途放弃。

examples.zh: 只要永不放弃，就还有机会。
examples.en: As long as you never give up, there is still a chance.

examples.zh: 这是一支永不放弃的球队。
examples.en: This is a team that never gives up.

usage.en: Often a slogan or motto; predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 常作口号或座右铭，作谓语或定语。

meaning.en: A husband and wife who get on well together.

equivalents: get along as husband and wife

examples.zh: 他们夫妻和睦，日子过得很幸福。
examples.en: The couple get on well and live happily.

examples.zh: 夫妻和睦是家庭幸福的基础。
examples.en: A harmonious marriage is the basis of a happy family.

usage.en: Predicate or subject; 和 is hé here.
usage.zh: 作谓语或主语，“和”读 hé。

meaning.en: The route is difficult and dangerous.

examples.zh: 进山的路途艰险，需要有经验的向导。
examples.en: The way into the mountains is treacherous and needs an experienced guide.

examples.zh: 尽管路途艰险，他们仍然义无反顾地出发了。
examples.en: Though the journey was perilous, they set out without hesitation.

usage.en: Predicate or concessive clause.
usage.zh: 作谓语或让步分句。

meaning.en: Living in extravagant and indulgent luxury.
meaning.zh: 生活铺张浪费，过分享受。

examples.zh: 这位官员生活奢靡，最后被查处。
examples.en: The official lived in extravagant luxury and was finally investigated.

examples.zh: 王朝末年，统治者生活奢靡，百姓困苦。
examples.en: At the dynasty's end the rulers lived in luxury while the people suffered.

usage.en: Formal and critical; predicate.
usage.zh: 较正式，含批评，作谓语。

meaning.en: Having wicked and harmful intentions.

examples.zh: 你别上当，他存心险恶，想骗你的钱。
examples.en: Don't be fooled: he has malicious intent and wants your money.

examples.zh: 这些谣言出自存心险恶的人之手。
examples.en: The rumours came from someone ill-intentioned.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (存心险恶的人).
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语。

meaning.en: Using cruel and vicious means to get one's way.

examples.zh: 这伙骗子手段狠毒，专门欺骗老年人。
examples.en: The gang use vicious methods and prey on the elderly.

examples.zh: 故事里的反派手段狠毒，却又让人胆寒。
examples.en: The villain in the story is ruthless and chilling.

usage.en: Predicate; criticism.
usage.zh: 作谓语，含批评。

meaning.en: The surroundings are quiet, secluded and beautiful.
meaning.zh: 周围的环境安静而美丽。

examples.zh: 这家疗养院环境幽美，适合休养。
examples.en: The sanatorium has lovely, peaceful surroundings, ideal for a rest.

examples.zh: 校园环境幽美，学生可以安静读书。
examples.en: The campus is quiet and pleasant, so students can study in peace.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often for parks, campuses, resorts.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，多用于公园、校园、疗养地。

meaning.en: Being very eager to find capable people to serve.
meaning.zh: 非常迫切地寻求有才能的人。

examples.zh: 公司求贤心切，开出了很高的薪水。
examples.en: Eager to find talent, the firm offered a very high salary.

examples.zh: 这位校长求贤心切，亲自去邀请专家。
examples.en: Keen to find able people, the head went in person to invite the expert.

usage.en: Predicate; often of rulers, bosses and institutions. 切 is qiè.
usage.zh: 作谓语，多用于君主、老板和机构，“切”读 qiè。

literal: what one has seen and heard · wide

meaning.en: Having seen and heard a great deal and so knowing about many things.
meaning.zh: 见到听到的事物多，知识面广。

examples.zh: 他走遍各地，见闻广博，大家爱听他讲故事。
examples.en: Having travelled widely, he is well-informed and people love his stories.

examples.zh: 导游见闻广博，沿途讲了许多趣事。
examples.en: The guide was widely knowledgeable and told many tales along the way.

usage.en: Describes a person; predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 形容人，作谓语或定语。

meaning.en: To disrupt the normal order of a place or event.

examples.zh: 几个球迷在场内扰乱秩序，被带离了现场。
examples.en: Several fans disturbed order in the ground and were led away.

examples.zh: 在考场扰乱秩序是要受处分的。
examples.en: Disrupting order in the exam hall brings a penalty.

usage.en: Verb-object; formal; common in laws, notices and news.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，较正式，常见于法规、告示和新闻。

meaning.en: Stubborn and unwilling to change one's mind, whatever others say.
meaning.zh: 性格强硬，认准了就不肯改变。

examples.zh: 爷爷脾气倔强固执，谁劝也不听。
examples.en: Grandpa is stubborn and obstinate, and won't listen to anyone.

examples.zh: 他倔强固执，从不肯认错。
examples.en: Obstinate as he is, he never admits being wrong.

usage.en: Describes personality; 倔 is juè (the surly sense). Can be mildly affectionate.
usage.zh: 形容性格，“倔”读 juè，有时略带亲昵。

meaning.en: To show off one's skill in speaking to impress others.

equivalents: show off one's gift of the gab

examples.zh: 他在会上卖弄口才，说了一大堆空话。
examples.en: He showed off his eloquence at the meeting and said a lot of empty words.

examples.zh: 别在面试官面前卖弄口才，要讲实际内容。
examples.en: Don't show off your talk in the interview; give real substance.

usage.en: Verb-object; derogatory.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，含贬义。

meaning.en: Unwilling to put up with hard work or discomfort.
meaning.zh: 怕苦怕累，不想付出辛苦。

examples.zh: 现在有些年轻人不愿吃苦，只想轻松赚钱。
examples.en: Some young people today won't put up with hardship and just want easy money.

examples.zh: 不愿吃苦的人，很难在这行做出成绩。
examples.en: Someone unwilling to endure hardship will hardly make a mark in this line.

usage.en: Predicate; often criticism. 吃苦 means endure hardship.
usage.zh: 作谓语，多含批评。

meaning.en: Standing together and helping one another.
meaning.zh: 大家团结一致，互相帮助。

equivalents: stand together and help each other

examples.zh: 班里同学团结互助，没有一个人掉队。
examples.en: The pupils in the class stood together and helped each other so that nobody fell behind.

examples.zh: 团结互助是我们小区一直的传统。
examples.en: Unity and mutual help are long-standing traditions in our neighbourhood.

usage.en: Predicate, attributive or noun-like; common in slogans.
usage.zh: 作谓语、定语，也常作口号。

meaning.en: Willing to spend money freely, especially to help others.

examples.zh: 他乐善好施，对公益事业从不吝钱财。
examples.en: Charitable by nature, he never begrudges money to public causes.

examples.zh: 为了孩子的教育，他们不吝钱财。
examples.en: For their child's education they spare no expense.

usage.en: Predicate; 吝 is lìn. Often 对…不吝钱财.
usage.zh: 作谓语，“吝”读 lìn，常用“对…不吝钱财”。
